planning.name: simulate_low
planning.description: Purchase a low-accuracy candidate trajectory for 1 credit. Returns x,y at all 16 times. Exact repeat is free.

planning.name: simulate_high
planning.description: Purchase a high-accuracy candidate trajectory for 8 credits. Returns x,y at all 16 times. Exact repeat is free.

planning.name: measure_target
planning.description: Purchase one noisy scalar from the fixed target for 12 credits. Existing observations are free. No candidate parameters accepted.

planning.name: get_status
planning.description: Free budget, purchase inventory, and submission status; no new evidence.

planning.name: evidence
planning.description: Retrieve all already available observations and purchased trajectories for free.

planning.name: compare_cached_candidates
planning.description: Free residual comparisons of purchased candidates against available target observations. Residuals are not parameter errors.

planning.name: fit_purchased
planning.description: Free approximate GP parameter fit using only purchased simulations and available observations. Requires at least one successful simulation; returns no acquisition recommendations.

planning.name: submit
planning.description: Submit a three-parameter estimate within the public bounds and end the episode. No private score is returned.

verification.name: simulate_low
verification.description: Explicit Euler step 0.1 at candidate theta; both populations on the half-unit grid. New trajectory costs 1 credit. The supplied original and exact purchased repeats are free. Returns predictions, not true errors or verdicts.

verification.name: simulate_high
verification.description: DOP853 at candidate theta, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12; both populations on the half-unit grid. New trajectory costs 8 credits; exact repeats are free. This integrates the candidate model, not the unknown target.

verification.name: measure_target
verification.description: Observe one scalar of the fixed target at a half-unit time from 0.5 through 8. New location costs 12 credits; retrieval of an existing observation is free and is NOT an independent replicate. Additive Gaussian noise has std 0.1 for x, 0.05 for y. Cannot select target parameters.

verification.name: evidence
verification.description: Free original report, original trajectory, all purchased simulations, and available target observations.

verification.name: get_status
verification.description: Free budget ledger. No private reference, true error, or verdict.

verification.name: compare_cached_candidates
verification.description: Free numerical comparison of purchased candidate predictions with available target observations. Uses only purchased evidence; does not grade the study's claims.

verification.name: submit
verification.description: End the investigation with ACCEPT, REJECT or ABSTAIN for every claim ID. Apply each claim's own formula, comparator and tolerance. Cite purchased/original/report evidence IDs and explain the numerical quantities supporting your verdicts. No more purchases after submission.
